title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dear Sir, we have come across a situation when a baby is born and is kept inside a Baby Incubator. However, we were not able to offer Azan,before the baby died. My question is: Do we still need to offer Namaz-eJanaza for the baby as the baby was born alive, but died without the Azaan was called. 10869 views Q. I am living in Kerala. Here there is custom of gathering people on the third day of demise and together reciting 100000 kalima tu Shahadah and making dua for the dead. Followed by distribution of food. What is the view on this activities in Shariah and sunna of the prophet? Should I attend these functions or not? 4484 views Q. Gayabana funeral prayer can pray or not? 2828 views Q. In mention of (Fatwa: 466/J) the you replied that "'It is prohibited to pray Janazah prayer in mosque premises, it is not right. The Janazah prayer should be performed outside mosque."' THEN WHY IS IT THAT JANAZAH NAMAAZ IS PRAYED IN THE HOLY HARAM? JAZAKALLAH 2194 views Q. How should a woman be buried 6818 views Q. One of my friend insists that there was no Nimaz E Janazah of Rasoolullah peace be upon him. Please let me know what is exctly right as per fiquah. 13562 views Q. Is it permissible to give poor and needy person food as isaale sawaab after the death of a muslim? 4481 views Q. One of my friends mother expired. whether he can recite quran, give food to poor and do good deeds and send the sawab of above acts to her dead mother. please clarify and quote the relevant hadees. 5767 views Q. Offering Namaz-e-Janaza in Masjid is "Mukrooh-e-Tehrimi". So One shall refrain to offer namaze Janaza if it is being held in Premises of Mosque? 6876 views Q. Assalamo Alaykum, Respected Mufti Sahab, Is Eesaal-e-Sawaab permissible for a living person? Jazaak Allah Khayr 2050 views Q. My son (our only child) was 4 months old when he died and whenever I visit his grave I kiss his grave with love 3337 views Q. I bought a home.thear is agrave in it.can i remove it? 2155 views Q. Assalamu alaikum rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. After salam-e-masnoon I have to state that star having six angles is used as religious symbol by jews. We want to print six angles star & moon in the covering cloth of Janazah. Is it permissible? Wassalam Imdadullah 1978 views Q. What is the proof (dalil) that after reading Holy Quran the reward can be sent to someone who is dead? 4205 views Q. The followers of Shafai madhhab are performing ghaibana namaz-e-janaza 7809 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 32712 Country: India Title: Some of deobandis also visit on Mazars of Hazrat Nizamuddin., Hazrat Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti etc.etc. Question: Some of deobandis also visit on Mazars of Hazrat Nizamuddin., Hazrat Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti etc.etc. They give the excuse that " we only visit there to read Fatiha upon them not like bareilwis who are doing Shirk. Hindus visit there and do totally wrong things.They consider THEM the God and ask THEM to fulfill their desires. Bareilwees also do wrong things alongwith apreciating the hindus to do Kufr activities instead of stopping the Hindus to perfomr Kufr activities. My question is that: 1. Should we visit the Mazars in that atmospheres? 2. whether we are doing wright to go there to read surah fatiha upon THEM? 3. whether we are not encouraging when standing with them at Mazars where Hindus are doing Kufr and Muslim Bareilwees are doing Shirk? 4. Should we not avoid these places and inspite of that we should visit our Kabristans to read surag fatiha upon our Buzurgs? Answer ID: 32712 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1018/854/B=1432) It is lawful to go to the grave of pious elders to read Fatiha etc, and if possible, one should try to stop the bida'h and nonsense done there. It does not imply favouring the Hindu practices and the wrong practices of Barelvis. It is good to do isal-e-sawab for common people by going to the graveyard and reading something. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
